items.title: German transport minister promotes green hydrogen in Japan
items.description: During a recent visit to Japan, Germany's transport minister Patrick Schnieder toured hydrogen projects aimed at bringing the fuel into the mainstream.

items.title: Middle East: Drone strike sparks fire at UAE nuclear plant
items.description: No party has claimed responsibility for the strike on the Barakah nuclear power plant, but Iran has repeatedly launched attacks on the UAE since the start of the war. Follow DW for more.

items.title: India news: CNG gas price hiked in Delhi NCR amid Iran war fallout
items.description: The price of CNG has increased in Delhi and the surrounding region for the second time in two days, as India grapples with the economic impact of the Iran war. Meanwhile, Modi is set to arrive in Sweden. DW has more.
